data.long_description:
This one-bedroom apartment for rent offers a well-planned layout, modern interiors and access to a comprehensive selection of lifestyle amenities.

The property features a spacious living and dining area, a fitted kitchen, a comfortable bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a modern bathroom. Large windows allow natural light to flow throughout the apartment, creating a bright and welcoming living environment.

Designed for convenience and comfort, the residence is ideal for professionals or couples seeking a quality home within a well-maintained and highly desirable community.

Property Features:

• One bedroom
• Spacious living and dining area
• Fitted kitchen
• Built-in wardrobes
• Ample natural light
• Practical layout
• Quality finishes

Community Amenities:

• Swimming pool
• Fully equipped gym
• Landscaped green spaces
• Walking and jogging tracks
• Children’s play areas
• Sports courts
• Outdoor fitness areas
• Barbecue and picnic areas
• Retail and dining outlets
• 24-hour security

The community provides a balanced lifestyle with convenient access to leisure, retail, dining and key destinations across Dubai.

Contact us for further information or to arrange a private viewing.
